lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Uhh... hello?

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: Hi Kim! Sorry to bother you.

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: Do you happen to have the official tracking number for the school publication's frozen operational fund?

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: I'm trying to fix a letter for Mrs. Santos.

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Oh! Let me check my student council binder..

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Oh no! It's not here…

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: I must have forgotten it in one of the corridor terraces!

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Can you perhaps.. Uh... get it for me?

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: Seriously??... Ughh. Fine.. All for that code.

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Have you found it?

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: I was just getting some air as I remember...

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: But uhh… I'm not so sure now...

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Aha! Here it is. Thank you so so much…

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Now let me find the code..

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: It's uhh… listed under code 'MGT-2004-FIN'.

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: MGT-2004-FIN.. Got it. Thanks, Kim!

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: This is exactly what I needed to make this letter ironclad.

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Good luck with that letter!

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Word around the office is that Mr. Reyes is tightening the purse strings...

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: ...for all student organizations this year.
